name: Legacy
description: The spells that began your journey have grown alongside you. Star Spark critical Charges restore 10 Mana. Matching all three natural Jellyfish dice summons a Perfect Jellyfish, dealing +20 bonus damage and restoring 20 HP + 20 Mana. If both of Moonbeam's natural main dice roll 20, a Full Moon forms and deals +75 bonus damage.
